🕴️ Pose: Hands in Pockets
Standing with hands tucked in pockets — casual, relaxed, and understated.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Hands in Pockets.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, place one or both frame-visible hands in pockets only when the selected Outfit visibly includes them. Otherwise rest the hands naturally near the hips or along the sides without inventing garment features. Female: shoulders drop, elbows close to the sides. Male: shoulders stay set, elbows carried out. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own resting arms.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
